description: List dispatch/schedule entries, optionally filtered by member, ticket, or date range (dates as YYYY-MM-DD). Use to see who is scheduled for what and when.

member.description: Member identifier the entry is assigned to

on_or_after.description: Only entries starting on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

on_or_before.description: Only entries starting on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

response_format.description: Output format: human-readable markdown (default) or structured JSON

ticket_id.description: Only entries scheduled for this ticket

name: cw_list_schedule_entries
title: List ConnectWise Schedule Entries
